17/*
18 * @brief A message indicating how long the switch-channel is expected to take,
19 * used for example when cac-started is handled and the cac-time is taken from it.
20 * When another task is asking for switch-channel (with switch-channel-request)
21 * it doesn't know how long to wait for the switch channel to happen.
22 * This message reports about the time it should take. receiving this message
23 * enables the caller to update its timeout before taking failure actions.
24 * With this message, the caller is careless about the actions taken to perform
25 * a switch-channel nor is concerned about cac or anything. it needs just to wait
26 * the time it is set in the duration_sec parameter before deciding on timeout.
27 *
28 * @param ifname The interface name this message relates to.
29 * @param duration_sec The time in seconds there is to wait for the switch channel.
30
31 */
32struct sSwitchChannelDurationTime {
33 std::string ifname;
34 std::chrono::seconds duration_sec;
35};
36std::ostream &operator<<(std::ostream &os,
37 const sSwitchChannelDurationTime &switch_channel_duration_time);
38
39/*
40 * @brief A message a indicating a switch channel happned
41 * with indication if the switch really happened. *
42 * (currently originated from csa-notification and csa-error-notification)
43 *
44 * @param ifname The interface name this message relates to.
45 * @param ap_channel_switch Values related to the channel.
46 * @param switched Boolean indication if really switched or error occurred.
47 */
48struct sSwitchChannelNotification {
49 std::string ifname;
50 beerocks_message::sApChannelSwitch ap_channel_switch;
51 bool switched;
52};

76/*
77 * @brief A request to switch a channel.
78 *
79 * @param ifname The interface name this message relates to.
80 * @param channel The channel to switch to.
81 * @param bandwidth The bandwidth to use.
82 */
83struct sSwitchChannelRequest {
84 sSwitchChannelRequest();
85 sSwitchChannelRequest(const sSwitchChannelRequest &rhs);
86
87 std::string ifname;
88 uint8_t channel = 0;
89 eFreqType freq_type = eFreqType::FREQ_UNKNOWN;
90 eWiFiBandwidth bandwidth = eWiFiBandwidth::BANDWIDTH_UNKNOWN;
91};
92std::ostream &operator<<(std::ostream &os, const sSwitchChannelRequest &switch_channel_request);

94/*
95 * @brief Possible end status of switch channel request.
96 */
97enum class eSwitchChannelReportStatus {
98 SUCCESS,
99 GENERAL_FAIL,
100 NO_SWITCH_CHANNEL_NOTIFICATION,
101 ANOTHER_SWITCH_IN_PROGRESS,
102 CAC_FAILED,
103 CSA_FAILED,
104 NOT_COMPUTED
105};

107/*
108 * @brief Switch channel report.
109 *
110 * @param cac_happened Indicates if cac happened during switch channel.
111 * @param original_request The original request that triggered the switch channel.
112 * @param switch_channel_notification The data related to the switch channel coming from the driver
113 * relevant if cac didn't happen.
114 * @param cac_started_notification The cac started data coming from the driver when cac started.
115 * @param cac_completed_notification The cac completed data coming from the driver when cac completed.
116 * @param status The status of the report. If not set may be computed by the struct itself
117 * based on the values of other members.
118 */
119struct sSwitchChannelReport {
120 sSwitchChannelReport();
121 sSwitchChannelReport(
122 bool cac_happened_, std::shared_ptr<const sSwitchChannelRequest> original_request_,
123 std::shared_ptr<sSwitchChannelNotification> switch_channel_notification_,
124 std::shared_ptr<sCacStartedNotification> cac_started_notification_,
125 std::shared_ptr<sCacCompletedNotification> cac_completed_notification_,
126 eSwitchChannelReportStatus status = eSwitchChannelReportStatus::NOT_COMPUTED);
127
128 /*
129 * @brief Based on the various values of the report
130 * calculates its status.
131 *
132 * @return The computed eSwitchChannelReportStatus.
133 */
134 eSwitchChannelReportStatus compute_switch_channel_report_status();
135
136 bool cac_happened;
137 std::shared_ptr<const sSwitchChannelRequest> original_request;
138 std::shared_ptr<sSwitchChannelNotification> switch_channel_notification;
139 std::shared_ptr<sCacStartedNotification> cac_started_notification;
140 std::shared_ptr<sCacCompletedNotification> cac_completed_notification;
141 eSwitchChannelReportStatus status;
142};
143std::ostream &operator<<(std::ostream &os, const sSwitchChannelReport &switch_channel_report);
